Atal Pension Yojana is a government-backed pension scheme targeted mainly at workers in the unorganized sector and functions under the regulatory framework of PFRDA.

items: Target Audience: APY focuses specifically on workers in the unorganized sector.
Regulator: PFRDA regulates the functioning of the Atal Pension Yojana.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Atal Pension Yojana (APY) is a government-backed pension scheme.
The scheme is designed primarily for workers in the unorganized sector.
It operates under the regulatory oversight of PFRDA.
